description: This file defines internal API prototypes for the BREE Site Resource Manager component, including functions for registering, unregistering, mapping, and loading cooked resources.

methods.name: BreeSrmoRegisterCookedResource
methods.description: Registers a cooked resource with the resource manager.

methods.name: BreeSrmoUnregisterCookedResource
methods.description: Unregisters a cooked resource from the resource manager.

methods.name: BreeSrmoMapCookedResource
methods.description: Maps a cooked resource URL to an internal handle.

methods.name: BreeSrmoLoadCookedResources
methods.description: Loads all cooked resources within the context.
